title: The Burning Salt Again
author: Dominic Amberdale
blurb: Lena Ishikawa, a hedge-witch's runaway apprentice, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now she must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
